name: Culver House
accommodation: Self-catering suites (one and two bedrooms per Tripadvisor listing)
beachAccess: About a one-minute walk to Port Eynon beach
overview: Culver House offers self-catering apartments a minute's walk from Port Eynon's beach, most of them with sea views. The suites have fully equipped kitchens, and dogs are accepted in some of them.
surfTripFit: You're a minute from the beach and can cook for yourself, which suits surfers who keep odd hours.
